description: Get full details for one veterinary clinic: address, phone number, website, opening hours, star rating with a short review summary, and booking link. Use after find_vets or find_emergency_vet when the user asks about a specific clinic's hours, phone number, reviews, or how to contact or book it. Read-only.

location.description: City or area, used with name when place_id is unknown.

name.description: Clinic name, used with location when place_id is unknown.

place_id.description: The clinic's place_id from find_vets or find_emergency_vet. Preferred.

name: get_vet_details
